rules.name: [OpenIRN] API indisponible depuis le moniteur synthétique
rules.query:
FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE service.name == "openirn-api" AND monitor.status != "up"
| STATS failed_checks = COUNT(*), last_failure = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE failed_checks >= 2
| KEEP failed_checks, last_failure

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Moniteur synthétique silencieux
rules.query:
FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE service.name == "openirn-api"
| STATS checks = COUNT(*)
| WHERE checks == 0
| KEEP checks

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Journal d'accès API silencieux
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| STATS events = COUNT(*)
| WHERE events == 0
| KEEP events

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Rafale d'erreurs HTTP 5xx
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500
| STATS errors_5xx = COUNT(*)
| WHERE errors_5xx >= 3
| KEEP errors_5xx

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Latence API p95 élevée
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.api-*
| STATS requests = COUNT(*), p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95)
| EVAL p95_ms = p95_ns / 1000000.0
| WHERE requests >= 5 AND p95_ms >= 500
| KEEP requests, p95_ms

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Échecs d'authentification ou d'autorisation répétés
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE event.action IN ("auth.failed", "auth.rate_limited", "authorization.denied")
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY source_hash = openirn.security.source_address_hash
| WHERE events >= 10
| KEEP events, source_hash
| SORT events DESC
| LIMIT 20

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Événement de sécurité de sévérité haute
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.security-*
| WHERE event.severity >= 7
| STATS events = COUNT(*), last_event = MAX(@timestamp) BY action = event.action
| WHERE events >= 1
| KEEP action, events, last_event
| SORT events DESC

rules.name: [OpenIRN] CPU élevé sur l'hôte OpenIRN
rules.query:
FROM metrics-system.cpu-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS samples = COUNT(*), cpu_avg_pct = AVG(system.cpu.total.norm.pct) * 100
| WHERE samples >= 5 AND cpu_avg_pct >= 85
| KEEP samples, cpu_avg_pct

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Mémoire élevée sur l'hôte OpenIRN
rules.query:
FROM metrics-system.memory-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS samples = COUNT(*), memory_avg_pct = AVG(system.memory.actual.used.pct) * 100
| WHERE samples >= 5 AND memory_avg_pct >= 90
| KEEP samples, memory_avg_pct

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Disque racine presque plein sur l'hôte OpenIRN
rules.query:
FROM metrics-system.filesystem-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.filesystem.mount_point == "/"
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 1
| EVAL disk_pct = system.filesystem.used.pct * 100
| WHERE disk_pct >= 85
| KEEP disk_pct

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Connexions MariaDB avortées en hausse
rules.query:
FROM metrics-mysql.status-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| EVAL aborted_connects = TO_LONG(mysql.status.aborted.connects)
| STATS samples = COUNT(*), aborted_min = MIN(aborted_connects), aborted_max = MAX(aborted_connects)
| EVAL aborted_delta = aborted_max - aborted_min
| WHERE samples >= 2 AND aborted_delta >= 5
| KEEP samples, aborted_delta

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Aucune sauvegarde réussie depuis 26 heures
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE event.action == "backup.created" AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS successful_backups = COUNT(*)
| WHERE successful_backups == 0
| KEEP successful_backups

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Échec de sauvegarde
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE event.action == "backup.failed" OR (event.action == "backup.created" AND event.outcome == "failure")
| STATS failed_backups = COUNT(*), last_failure = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE failed_backups >= 1
| KEEP failed_backups, last_failure

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Erreurs du proxy Apache
rules.query:
FROM logs-apache.error-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND (apache.error.module == "proxy" OR apache.error.module == "proxy_http" OR MATCH(message, "proxy"))
| STATS proxy_errors = COUNT(*), last_error = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE proxy_errors >= 1
| KEEP proxy_errors, last_error

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Workers Apache saturés
rules.query:
FROM metrics-apache.status-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS busy = LATEST(apache.status.workers.busy), idle = LATEST(apache.status.workers.idle)
| EVAL workers_total = busy + idle
| EVAL saturation_pct = CASE(workers_total > 0, busy * 100.0 / workers_total, 0.0)
| WHERE saturation_pct >= 90
| KEEP busy, idle, saturation_pct

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Utilisation élevée du swap
rules.query:
FROM metrics-system.memory-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__"
| STATS samples = COUNT(*), swap_avg_pct = AVG(system.memory.swap.used.pct) * 100
| WHERE samples >= 5 AND swap_avg_pct >= 50
| KEEP samples, swap_avg_pct

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Service systemd OpenIRN inactif
rules.query:
FROM metrics-linux.service-*
| WHERE host.name == "__OPENIRN_MONITORED_HOST__" AND system.service.name IN ("openirn-api.service", "openirn-api-backup.timer", "apache2.service", "mariadb.service")
| STATS state = LATEST(system.service.state), sub_state = LATEST(system.service.sub_state) BY service = system.service.name
| WHERE state != "active"
| KEEP service, state, sub_state

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Certificat TLS à renouveler
rules.query:
FROM synthetics-http-*
| WHERE service.name == "openirn-api" AND tls.server.x509.not_after IS NOT NULL
| STATS certificate_expiry = MAX(tls.server.x509.not_after)
| EVAL days_remaining = DATE_DIFF("day", NOW(), certificate_expiry)
| WHERE days_remaining <= 30
| KEEP certificate_expiry, days_remaining

rules.name: [OpenIRN] Redémarrages répétés de l'API
rules.query:
FROM logs-openirn.operations-*
| WHERE event.action == "service.started"
| STATS api_starts = COUNT(*), last_start = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE api_starts >= 3
| KEEP api_starts, last_start
